title: Introducer Thank You – ThePaymaster®
heading: Introducer Referral Program

Success

Welcome to ThePaymaster® Introducer Program!

Thank you for joining our community of trusted introducers.

Your application has been successfully received, and we’re delighted to welcome you aboard.

One of our team will email you shortly.

Your Next Steps

Complete Your Verification

To ensure secure payment processing and maintain our high compliance standards, please complete your verification process, please have your passport and banking information ready:

For Introducers with corporate banking:



Click or scan the QR code to complete your corporate verification

For Introducers using their individual bank account:



Click or scan the QR code to complete your individual verification

  • Important Information

    Your registered email is your unique identifier for all referrals
  • ⁠Please ensure clients quote this email when they register with ThePaymaster®
  • ⁠Your introducer rewards will be automatically tracked through this email

    Payment Processing
  • Receive 10% of ThePaymaster® fee for every client you introduce
  • Payments processed automatically when we receive fees
  • No need to chase payments – you get paid when we get paid

Need to update your details in the future? Simply email us at briefus@thepaymaster.co.uk.

We’re excited to begin this partnership with you. Should you have any questions, our team is here to help.
